verdict.rationale: Conductor documents a public API for managing cloud workspaces programmatically, covering creating workspaces, sending prompts to the coding agent, and reading its replies. A first-party hosted MCP server exposes the same workspace management to agent clients. Missing for 10: API scope is limited to cloud workspaces (local Mac-app workflows are not shown as API-drivable), no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), no endpoint/auth reference detail in evidence, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
